Subject: Aligning demo goals, attendees, and two candidate times

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side and a proposed next step to lock a 30‑minute product intro that focuses on the items you called out.

Recap / goals (from our call)
- Primary goal: validate how Redwood can reduce per‑request latency and token cost for your internal summarization pipeline while retaining accuracy.
- Success criteria for the session: a) live run of a short internal prompt with your sample data or a synthetic equivalent, b) expected latency/throughput targets for 8‑minute sequences, c) next steps for a pilot (guardrails + data handling).

Who to invite
- Please include 1) your product owner (for success criteria), 2) an infra or SRE contact (for latency/arch questions), and 3) a security/compliance contact if you want to validate data handling in the call.

Two 30‑minute candidate slots (PT) — pick one or propose alternatives:
- Option A: Tue Apr 27, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Option B: Wed Apr 28, 13:00–13:30 PT

Prep / attachments
- I attached a short pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.md) — if you can share the sample prompt and a redacted payload beforehand that will make the session far more actionable.

Next steps
- Reply with the preferred slot and attendee list. I’ll send an invite and loop in Priyom (solutions engineering) to lead the technical portion.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122
